debug.title: Invoice diagnostics
debug.description:
Choose a PDF invoice from a supplier that is not supported yet. The integration extracts its text and masks personal data (name, address, personal ID, customer and account numbers, meter numbers, phone, e-mail, IBAN). **The file is not stored.**

Review the text, copy it and send it in a [GitHub new supplier request]({issue_url}).

data_description.mask: Comma-separated words, e.g. your name or street if they remain visible.

abort.debug_parsed:
✅ Recognised invoice from **{supplier}**: No. {number}, {m3} m³, {cost} {currency}. It is already supported - upload it from „Upload invoices“.

Masked items: **{masked}**. Review the text - if anything personal remains, run the diagnostics again and add it to „Also hide“.

Copy the text and send it in a [new supplier request]({issue_url}):

```
{text}
```
abort.debug_unsupported:
❓ This supplier is not supported yet.

Masked items: **{masked}**. Review the text - if anything personal remains, run the diagnostics again and add it to „Also hide“.

Copy the text and send it in a [new supplier request]({issue_url}):

```
{text}
```
